title: 丛芳榭 Congfang Xie
subtitle: Changchun Yuan

model.line: 9 boxes stand in this compound, 9 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 御製叢芳榭得句
evidence.excerpt_zh: 乾隆二十四年御製叢芳榭得句　曲廊廻抱疎軒敞階俯臨池波泱漭繚以紗疎碧且虚延爽障寒幽復朗宴息四序無不宜恒春花鎮含芳㽔風欄雨埭氤氲際月宇雪牕澹蕩時摛藻發思真契妙一嵗之中曽㡬到今來憇即今年初却笑何須亟營造
evidence.summary: Poem on 叢芳榭: curved gallery, open hall and steps down to the pool, with a note on how rarely he comes.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 丛芳榭
evidence.excerpt_zh: 平疇交逺風之東為叢芳榭後為琴清齋（長春園册）臣等謹案琴清齋内額曰霞蹤天想
evidence.summary: East of 平疇交逺風: 叢芳榭 and 琴清齋 behind it.

evidence.title: 琴清斋
evidence.locator: v3 p.373, under 狮子林; source ref 6-695
evidence.excerpt_zh: 髙斋枕碧川，琴清名有年。徒观澄止水，未听鸣响泉。却讶渊明室，别体蓄无弦。
evidence.summary: Poem 琴清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

evidence.title: 琴清斋
evidence.locator: v3 p.373, under 狮子林; source ref 8-763
evidence.excerpt_zh: 书斋临水号琴清，正是春温和且平。何必七弦虞拨剌，由来太古自然声。
evidence.summary: Poem 琴清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

evidence.title: 琴清斋口号
evidence.locator: v3 p.407, under 狮子林; source ref 18-619
evidence.excerpt_zh: 远瀑漫寻七弦比，近湖恒对五音清。那更陶壁相唐突，个里无声却有声。
evidence.summary: Poem 琴清斋口号 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1793, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

evidence.title: 丛芳榭
evidence.locator: v3 p.412, under 狮子林; source ref 1-171
evidence.excerpt_zh: 百卉盛韶春，稍觉太艳丽。我来过重阳，寻芳趁秋霁。傍榭一丛金，掩映东篱际。清标接渚荷，仙品匹月桂。黄蕤日色含，叶傲朝霜厉。彭泽有素心，空谷同辟世。
evidence.summary: Poem 丛芳榭 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

evidence.title: 丛芳榭
evidence.locator: v3 p.414, under 狮子林; source ref 1-327
evidence.excerpt_zh: 廿四番过花信风，群芳绕榭绮罗丛。莺梭巧织栁丝绿，燕翦匀裁桃瓣红。叠叠波光摇潋滟，迟迟旭影乐冲融。袷衣初试昼方永，人坐熙春和气中。
evidence.summary: Poem 丛芳榭 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

evidence.title: 丛芳榭得句
evidence.locator: v3 p.372, under 狮子林; source ref 6-692
evidence.excerpt_zh: 曲廊回抱疏轩敞，阶俯琳池波泱漭。缭以纱疏碧且虚，延爽障寒幽复朗。宴息四序无不宜，恒春花镇含芳蕤。风栏雨埭氤氲际，月宇雪窗澹荡时。摛藻发思真契妙，一岁之中曾几到。今来憩即今年初，却笑何须亟营造。
evidence.summary: Poem 丛芳榭得句 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 狮子林
evidence.summary: Two gardens: 丛芳榭 of 1747 (five-bay hall on the lake, 琴清斋 behind, 漾月 and 集虚 pavilions), and from 1772 the Suzhou copy to its north-east. It lists the sixteen scenes, and says Qianlong's copy of Ni Zan's painting was kept in 清閟阁. Partly rebuilt 1828.

evidence.title: 海岳开襟; 映清斋; 蒨园; 鉴园; 狮子林 (search-index text)
evidence.summary: 海岳开襟: lake islet about 90 m across, about 1,000 m2 of buildings, by 1747, repaired 1778 and 1791; a totem park stood here 1995-2007. 映清斋: added 1766 as a new palace of 玉玲珑馆. 蒨园: 6,600 m2, 2,300 m2 of buildings, 1752. 鉴园: repaired 1810. 狮子林: west part with 丛芳榭 by 1747, the east in imitation of Suzhou finished 1772.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
